title: Healthcare RCM — Denial Management
tagline: Turn a claim denial into a filed appeal in minutes, not a week of chart-chasing.
painPoint: Denial write-offs pile up because appeals take a coder half a day of digging through the chart to assemble.

steps.caption: The RCM Strategist
steps.talk: This is the strategist view for denial management — where a denied claim gets triaged for appeal-worthiness.

steps.caption: Denial detail
steps.talk: This is the denial itself — the payer's reason code, the dollar amount, and the timeline pressure.

steps.caption: Back to the strategist run
steps.talk: Returning to the run panel to fire the analysis.

steps.caption: Run the strategist
steps.talk: One click runs the full denial analysis — payer pattern recognition, appeal-success likelihood, and root-cause classification.

steps.caption: Reasoning, fully shown
steps.talk: Here's the reasoning chain behind that recommendation — exactly what a compliance officer needs to sign off on an appeal.

steps.caption: Escalate to executive portal
steps.talk: One click escalates the case with full denial context attached.

steps.caption: Executive KPIs, live
steps.talk: Denial exposure and recovery rate, live — not a spreadsheet someone updates once a week.

steps.caption: Escalation detail opens
steps.talk: Drilling into this specific case from the executive view.

steps.caption: The denial pack
steps.talk: This is the tab that generates the actual appeal packet.

steps.caption: Auto-generated appeal packet
steps.talk: One click and the appeal packet writes itself — citations, chart references, and payer-specific argument, ready to submit. This is the step that used to eat half a coder's day.

steps.caption: Back to the numbers
steps.talk: And the recovery-rate KPI updates the moment that appeal goes out — leadership sees the impact in real time.

cta: TSM turns a half-day appeal-writing task into a two-minute, defensible appeal packet.
